{"metadata":{"description":"DSH plugin that coordinates Codex planning and independent review while DSH executes.","id":"gh:1339589595","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-codex-workflow","slug":"kui123456789/dsh-codex-workflow","topics":["code-review","codex","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH plugin that coordinates Codex planning and independent review while DSH executes."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-codex-workflow"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives Codex read-only planning/review roles while DSH remains the sole "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"executor. Two flows share the same workflow engine:"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"From a source checkout, run `pnpm demo` and open `http://127.0.0.1:4175` for a standalone local visu"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"al demo. It uses simulated events to demonstrate planning, execution, review and same-thread recover"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"y without connecting to DSH or a model. See the demo guide."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Codex-led bridge (preferred)** — the Codex task that produced the plan sends it to the exact liv"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"e DSH session through a durable SQLite bridge; DSH implements it, and the plugin runs the review in "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"private App Server ephemeral threads before returning the verdict to the original DSH session (the o"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"riginating Codex task is never resumed or written; it receives the outcome through the bridge relay)"},{"id":"p5s5","text":".
- **DSH-led tools** — the DSH agent can autonomously start `codex_workflow_start` for complex deve"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"lopment tasks, or the user can request it explicitly; implementation and review still run through th"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"e same workflow engine."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"No browser is opened or controlled anywhere in the product path; no network listener, MCP, hooks, or"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" skills are involved. Browser clicking is a development-only workaround and is not part of the plugi"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"kills are involved. Browser clicking is a development-only workaround and is not part of the plugin."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Execution split (ephemeral review surface)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Planner and Reviewer turns run through the NPM Codex CLI's `codex app-server --stdio`, but plugin-cr"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"eated threads use `thread/start { ephemeral: true }`. They remain available for the current App Serv"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"er process, do not receive Desktop names, and do not appear in `thread/list`. Failure recovery and c"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"larification answers require the original process and handle. A lost original thread reports an erro"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"r; neither path reconstructs a replacement Planner. Structured conversion and authority alignment co"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ntinue to use `codex exec --ephemeral` or an equivalent private App Server turn."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Planner and Reviewer runs use DSH's `subagents.start()` on legacy hosts; on activation-only hosts su"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ch as 0.2.1-rc.3, this plugin owns the native one-shot mirror lifecycle. Each gets a native child Se"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ssion (`origin: "subagent"`) while the NPM Codex App Server executes the task in an ephemeral thread"},{"id":"p9s4","text":". The child Session receives native assistant stream frames and a final message. The browser opens D"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"SH's built-in `subagentchat` right-sidebar resource for that child, so Codex appears as a child agen"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"t conversation. Workflow status and final review metadata use the `codexWorkflow` projection on lega"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"cy hosts or plugin-owned SQLite state on activation-only hosts. Private reasoning text and raw tool "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"output are not forwarded. The plugin never opens or focuses Codex Desktop."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Concurrent SDK callers share one App Server initialization, with independent cancellation of each ca"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ller's wait. Cancelling one observer preserves the original process for observers still waiting; onl"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"y the last withdrawal abandons initialization and cleans its original process. A later independent r"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"equest waits for that cleanup before initializing again. Permanent plugin stop prevents another boot"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"strap. These initialization rules do not restore a lost ephemeral Planner or authorize a replacement"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"se initialization rules do not restore a lost ephemeral Planner or authorize a replacement workflow."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2` (the development and type-check baseline; the declared peer range al"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"so accepts `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.3`)
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24`
- Codex CLI "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"with a valid ChatGPT login and App Server support (verified by `pnpm doctor`)"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Upgrading after a DSH update"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin is developed and type-checked against DSH `0.1.7-rc.2` with cordis `4.0.4`; its declared "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"peer range also accepts DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.3`. Run `pnpm host:check` agai"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"nst the **operator's installed** core packages (isolated temp storage, no live profile/session/model"},{"id":"p15s4","text":") before treating a host as verified; the check also asks the host's own `evaluatePluginCompatibilit"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"y` to judge the declared range. Set `DSH_CODEX_HOST_PACKAGE_JSON` to the desktop application's bundl"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ed `@deepseek-ai/dsh/package.json` when the desktop and CLI installations differ. Use an isolated bu"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"ild when a live profile links to this checkout."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"On activation-only hosts such as DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`, sidebar state lives in the plugin's `coord.sqlite"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"` and is read through the authenticated `workflow-state` RPC; no custom workflow events are appended"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" to the host's Session log. Hosts with the legacy subagent API keep their existing projection path. "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"Codex one-shot child conversations remain native Sessions, with this plugin owning their lifecycle o"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"n activation-only hosts; they do not start the parent model loop. Existing historical chat logs are "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"never rewritten: legacy logs containing unsupported required event types need separate migration bef"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ore the new host can reopen them."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Two things matter when the host moves:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **The host judges the peer range itself.** At profile startup `dsh` checks every `@deepseek-ai/dsh"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"*` peer against the running version and asks for an exact-version exemption when one is unsatisfied "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"(`dsh plugin allow-version`). Its documented semantics let **prereleases participate in ranges**, so"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" a range is not judged by plain npm semver — that is why the gate reuses the host's evaluator instea"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"d of re-implementing it. `pnpm doctor` reports the same verdict (SKIPPED, never passed, when no DSH "},{"id":"p18s6","text":"profile exists), so `pnpm release:check` inherits it.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Host compatibility (DSH 0.1.7 contract, introduced in 1.1.3)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"DSH `0.1.7` replaced the shared catch-all `plugin` message source with a **merge-extensible sum type"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"**: `MessageSourceMap` is augmented by each producer in its own module, and `MessageSource.kind` ans"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"wers *who produced this* while `form` answers *what kind of thing it is* (the two axes are deliberat"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ely independent). There is no `plugin` kind to borrow any more."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The plugin therefore declares its own kind in `src/message-source.ts` — exactly the way first-party "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"producers such as `dsh-agent-instructions` do — and builds every injected message from it (`relaySou"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rce()` for a plan handoff / verdict / outcome, `noticeSource(summary)` for a one-off notice). A cast"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" would have compiled, but it would have hidden the contract from the compiler and left the harness u"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"nable to attribute this plugin's context to a declared producer."}],"truncated":true}
